$comment: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (imagodei Attestation entry, kind='hardware-custody'). Category A. Declares the legal/social custodian-of-record for a registered doorway's underlying hardware. The custodian is the human (or collective) of record — they own the box, pay the bills, decide the hardware's end-of-life, and authorize who serves as steward-of-record. Custody changes are real-world events (death, sale, gift, household reorganization); they must be witnessed by the succession quorum named at attestation time. Reach: commons (current custodian is publicly auditable by hosted users and federated peers). Quorum SETUP (who's in the quorum) is also commons — the secret material those quorum members hold lives at intimate reach in recovery_seed_commitments per Recovery Phase 2.
title: HardwareCustodyAttestationMetadata
description: Per-subtype metadata for attestation:hardware-custody. Asserts that the signing agent (or a collective agent) is the custodian-of-record for the hardware behind the named doorway. For the duration of this attestation's validity, this agent holds the authority to issue (and revoke) steward-of-record attestations for the same doorway.

doorwayId.description: DoorwayRegistration.id this custody covers. Until hardware-fingerprinting lands in compute reporting, this is the bound identity. Migration of custody to a different DoorwayRegistration is itself a transfer event (see custody-transfer-metadata.schema.json).

custodianAgent.description: Agent public key claiming custody. May be a household_collective_key, an individual agent_key, or a recovery_committee key — anything the protocol recognizes as an agent identity.

successionQuorum.description: M-of-N quorum authorized to attest a custody transfer when the custodian becomes unavailable (death, incapacitation, voluntary stepping-down). Reused from Recovery Phase 2 — these agents appear in recovery_witnesses table; the seed material they hold lives privately in recovery_seed_commitments at intimate reach.

thresholdM.description: Number of witness signatures required to authorize a transfer (M-of-N).

witnessAgents.description: Agent public keys of the witnesses. Must include at least thresholdM members. Membership is commons-reach; the seed shares they custody are not.

validFrom.description: ISO8601 timestamp this custody takes effect.

predecessorAttestationHash.description: ActionHash of the prior HardwareCustodyAttestation this one supersedes. Null on the genesis attestation (issued at doorway first boot or hardware acquisition). Non-null custody attestations MUST be paired with a HardwareCustodyTransferAttestation that names this predecessor.

evidenceCid.description: Optional CID of supporting real-world documentation (deed of sale, will, transfer-of-custody letter). Off-DHT; the CID is a discoverable pointer for human review.

reachClass.description: Visibility of this custody attestation. Defaults to commons so hosted users + federated peers can audit. stewards-only is a narrowed option for private federations; not recommended for general use.
